name: Equip lists read the Equip line; Fortified land, Giant's Amulet, Eater of Virtue, Luxior
notes: Memory: project_audit_equip_2026-11-11. extractActivatedAbilities read only 'Equip {cost}', so 'Equip legendary creature {1}', 'Equip Knight {1}', 'Equip planeswalker {1}', 'Equip—Pay 3 life.', 'Equip {2} or {B}' and 'Equip {3}. This ability costs …' were no ability at all (46 lines); they are now, with equipQuality, and the pop-up's list (getEquipCandidates, lifted out of openEquipModal) reads the quality as 'target <quality> creature you control' ('Shaman, Warlock, or Wizard': the comma-list reader now ends a list at ', or'; 'worthy' from Mjolnir's reminder text). Eater of Virtue and Bride's Gown / Groom's Finery lost 'Equip {N}' from their abilities: a normaliser moved a sentence onto a new line mid-text, shifting the conditional-line indices; the moved sentences now go at the end. 'Fortified land has indestructible' was a global effect on lands with an 'Equipped' trait; the land is now Fortified and the effect targeted. Giant's Amulet's quoted 'This creature has hexproof' gave every permanent hexproof. Luxior's planeswalker kept the Planeswalker type (setTarget and requiresCreatureTarget refused a non-creature). Luxior's planeswalker had no P/T (null): a planeswalker added through the site had no loyalty counters (addPermanent now gives it its printed loyalty, CR 306.5b), and a creature with no P/T is now 0/0 from layer 7a (engine-layer), so Jace Beleren with Luxior is a 3/3 non-planeswalker creature.
